headline: Free Fire and Free Fire MAX
title: Free Fire Facts | One Billion Downloads | Classic Games
video_script: Free Fire is a battle royale game by Garena that became the first battle royale to pass one billion downloads on Google Play. In September twenty twenty one, Garena launched Free Fire MAX worldwide with better graphics, and players on both versions can play in the same matches. Which one do you play? Comment below!
description: Free Fire by Garena passed one billion Google Play downloads; Free Fire MAX launched September 28, 2021. Sources: Wikipedia, Garena press release, PocketGamer.biz.
joke: Nobody ever lands quietly, not even the parachute.
